description: Test suite for TUI-related functions and features in a TypeScript project, including command parsing, session management, and error handling.

methods.name: resolveFinalAssistantText
methods.description: Determines the assistant's final display text based on provided final, streamed, or error message data.

methods.name: parseCommand
methods.description: Parses slash commands in the TUI, with special handling for aliases.

methods.name: getSlashCommands
methods.description: Retrieves available slash commands, including gateway text commands.

methods.name: resolveTuiSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves a session key based on scope, raw input, and current agent context.

methods.name: resolveInitialTuiAgentId
methods.description: Infers or determines the initial TUI agent ID based on configuration, current working directory, and explicit session input.

methods.name: resolveGatewayDisconnectState
methods.description: Provides guidance and status based on gateway disconnect reasons.

methods.name: createBackspaceDeduper
methods.description: Creates a function to deduplicate backspace key events within a specified time window.

methods.name: resolveCtrlCAction
methods.description: Determines action (clear, warn, exit) in response to Ctrl+C based on timing and input state.

methods.name: isIgnorableTuiStopError
methods.description: Checks if a stop error from TUI is ignorable based on error code and syscall.

methods.name: stopTuiSafely
methods.description: Executes a cleanup callback, swallowing known ignorable errors during TUI shutdown.

ctags.name: state
ctags.pattern: /^    const state = resolveGatewayDisconnectState("gateway closed (1008): pairing required");$/
